base_configuration.calibration: seed0: 64 OpenWebMath plus 64 CodeParrot sequences, 512 tokens
base_configuration.scope: non-head Linear weights; lm_head, embeddings, norms, and KV cache excluded
base_configuration.evaluation: fake-quantized/dequantized BF16 on exact frozen WikiText/C4 windows

input_gate.mistral_status: eligible only after this protocol and all analysis code hashes are frozen

screening.criterion: minimum directional empirical power >=0.80 for |delta_log_ppl|=0.003 OR paired 95% CI half-width <=0.0025
screening.promotion: All valid primary arms enter full evaluation regardless of screening outcome. Qwen screening equals full evaluation and is not duplicated.

map_definitions.shared_reference: Reconstruct the frozen k=3 conjunction independently from float64 N16 moments and require bitwise mask equality to the verified primary map before writing a mechanism-protocol map.
map_definitions.ranking: Allocate floor(25% of conjunction-selected tiles) by deterministic largest remainder proportional to selected support per exact layer/projection module, capped at floor(support/3). Within each module select largest combined margin as strongest, smallest positive margin as weakest, and a SHA256-keyed disjoint draw from the remainder as random. All three have identical per-module counts.
map_definitions.veto: For each one-objective-pass class, propose the globally strongest approving-objective margins up to floor(25% of conjunction count). Bin the approving margin into five frozen global quantile bins. In each exact module/bin cell reduce to disjoint common support when needed, retain the strongest proposed tiles, and draw a SHA256-keyed control from the remaining class tiles. Actual and control counts are identical in every module/bin cell.
map_definitions.interaction: Partition the exact conjunction map into disjoint self-attention and MLP modules. For each module draw a SHA256-keyed uniform random mask with the exact conjunction count. The actual and random unions are exact disjoint attention/MLP unions.

mistral_promotion_rule: Launch exactly once only after both development evaluations are valid, map/accounting invariants pass, the analysis code hashes below remain unchanged, no co-tenancy violation exists, and projected completion precedes the hour-20 launch cutoff. Do not inspect any Mistral mechanism outcome before those conditions hold.

statistics.fundamental_endpoint: paired natural document/article-cluster delta NLL, equal to delta-log-PPL

families.A_development: all predeclared strongest/weakest/random group-only and full-context marginal pairwise contrasts across two development models and two corpora
families.B_development: for both veto classes: mean actual-minus-full, mean actual-minus-random, q90/q95/q99/worst/probability-of-regression actual-minus-random across two development models and two corpora
families.C_development: actual interaction residual and actual-minus-random residual across two development models and two corpora
families.A_validation: Mistral strongest-minus-weakest group-only and full-context marginal on two corpora
families.B_validation: Mistral KL-vetoed/CE-approved mean and tail family on two corpora
families.C_validation: Mistral actual and actual-minus-random interaction residuals on two corpora

hypothesis_gates.ranking_not_calibration: Support requires all four development marginal strongest-minus-weakest estimates <0, at least three Holm-significant, and at least three of four group-only directions <0. Existing frozen individual-tile sign/calibration evidence remains a required counterpoint.
hypothesis_gates.ce_kl_veto: For each of both veto classes, actual add-back must be worse than full and its matched random in at least three of four development model/corpus endpoints, with at least two Holm-significant endpoints; both classes must pass.
hypothesis_gates.attention_mlp_interaction: Actual interaction residual must have the same nonzero sign in all four development model/corpus endpoints and at least three must be Holm-significant.
hypothesis_gates.mistral_interpretation: One-shot analysis validation only; never a fully independent model-family generalization claim.

gpu_policy.device_family: NVIDIA RTX A6000 only for this campaign
gpu_policy.foreign_process_action: invalidate only this attempt, stop only its own container, preserve evidence, requeue; never signal the foreign process

claims_prohibited: individual-tile causality unless newly established under this frozen protocol
